provenance: climate-transition-risk-platform, MASTER_PROFILE.md sections 4b/4c (re-audited 2026-08-24). All figures are committed backtest/gate outputs, not invented series.

backtest.label: Rolling-origin backtest reproduction
backtest.note: 6 origins (2010–2022), 19 G20 countries. The bootstrap model's median absolute error closely reproduces a documented scratch finding; its interval coverage does not — and that miss is reported, not tuned away.

coverage.note: 90% prediction-interval coverage measured at 76.3% across 114 splits — an open undercoverage finding, published as-is.

energyGate.label: Energy-transition feature (M6): pre-registered promotion gate
energyGate.note: The energy component was promoted to production only after clearing all of the checks below. v1 (pre-existing baseline) is kept as a permanent comparison score; v2 is the energy-augmented production score. Both are computed and published side by side.

rejectedTrack.label: Regime-aware forecasting (M7): built, evaluated, not shipped
rejectedTrack.note: Structural-break and recency-weighted forecasting was implemented and evaluated. Gains were small, country robustness failed, and P5–P95 coverage stayed below the 90% target — so the decision was to keep the existing empirical-bootstrap model in production. Documented in ADRs 0011–0014.
